fields.name: hitchhikers
fields.description: Only from `resend`: events that waited for this update, in order. Handle each `[event, payload]` as if the server sent it now. The list is not sent again. Not all of them answer a request: a `game_response` `condition` from `add_condition` can come at any time (a skill of another character, a monster, the anniversary event).
